cards.title: Today’s vocabulary
sections: last name · /ˈlæst neɪm/ · noun phrase · Phrase · New
a family name; also called a surname. My last name is Chen.
a title traditionally used before the name of an unmarried woman or a girl. Please use Miss Lee if that is her preferred title.
a title used before an adult man's surname. This is Mr. Chen.
a title used before an adult woman's surname without saying whether she is married. Please call me Ms. Chen.
a woman's title traditionally used by married women. Her preferred title is Mrs. Brown.
Cover the words. Say three from memory. Make a new sentence with one, then check the example.

articulation.label: name
articulation.alt: name: /n/ → /eɪ/ → /m/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
/ɪ/: Raise the front tongue; narrow the jaw gap.
/m/: Close both lips; air goes through the nose.
